scope: Presemantic source library and native query consumer; Vala C0 retains type checking and all lowering.

declarations.async runtime: Typed AsyncRuntimeSyntax name and its error/status type children; current syntax/runtime fixtures are continuity inputs, not a new runtime qualification.

address/move/release/UTF8 factory: current compiler source and selected preserved library inputs
references.typed traversal: Generated child scheduling covers every concrete schema family. C rows record actual visit counts; mapping is not a claim of every semantic branch being executed.

1.reason: Receiver/nominal member, method, property or projection needs semantic receiver classification

2.reason: Implicit this/base receiver and lifecycle context

3.reason: Aggregate initializer field needs destination type

4.reason: Match variant/payload selection needs scrutinee type

5.reason: Finite compiler-recognized intrinsic; arguments remain traversed and ordinary unknown names fail

6.reason: slots marker only in initialization of a declared owner-slot field on this

non_references: Capability and policy names governed by later semantic registries
Foreign ABI metadata strings except the specifically bound native caller-information target
Duplicate inherited/metadata AST views and generated property factory mirrors
downstream: Query CLI uses reference_at and symbol reverse lists over retained typed tables, including cross-file targets, sibling identities, deferred selections, ambiguity and internal errors.

C0_projection.compare: Exact source IDs, names, kinds and bindable reference targets; independent explicit byte-span expectations remain separate.
C0_projection.exclude: C0 synthetic foreach/throw temporary locals named after reserved keywords; checked detail strings; receiver-dependent target edges.
C0_projection.generic_names: Materialized display names project to template heads while source IDs remain exact.
C0_projection.lexical_policy: C0 forbids hiding active locals, parameters and visible constants; sibling scopes can reuse names.

complexity: Open-addressed names with geometric growth; lexical queries visit parent scopes; imported lookup visits ordered imports; source-offset query scans references. No worst-case O(1), global O(n), or isolated throughput claim.
qualification: Focused maintained run.py and continuity.py, O0/O2, actual C0 tooling, independent expectations, output corruption controls, actual AST span mutation preserving SyntaxDump, partial construction, Valgrind, source lifetime and current-source integration. Raw receipts stay outside Git.
